text: The pipeline begins with the natural language description of the application.
The text is tokenized and pre-processed, extracting literal strings into token mappings.
The pre-processed tokens are fed into the Encoder of the Seq2seq Neural Network.
The representations then flow into the Decoder.
The Decoder outputs a Simplified App Representation, or SAR, containing structural component tags.
The SAR specification is then processed by the SAR Compiler.
This generates MIT App Inventor Source files, including dot SCM and dot BKY files, along with the extracted strings.
Next, the MIT App Inventor backend Compiler builds the source files.
The compiler outputs the final APK, ready to use on a mobile device.
